name: Typesense
description: Cutting-edge, in-memory search engine for mere mortals. Knowledge of rocket science optional.
composeYaml:
services:
  typesense:
    image: 'typesense/typesense:28.0'
    environment:
      - 'TYPESENSE_ENABLE_CORS=${TYPESENSE_ENABLE_CORS:-true}'
      - TYPESENSE_DATA_DIR=/data
      - 'TYPESENSE_API_KEY=${TYPESENSE_API_KEY:?}'
    volumes:
      - 'typesense_data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bash
        - '-c'
        - 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/8108 && printf ''GET /health HTTP/1.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n'' >&3 && head -n1 <&3 | grep ''200'' && exec 3>&-'
      retries: 5
      timeout: 7s

meta.about: Blazing fast, typo-tolerant open source search engine optimized for developer happiness and ease of use.
